get.description: The process is up. Says nothing about the database; that is /readyz.
Ready to serve: the database and Redis both answer. 503 otherwise, so traffic waits.

post.description: Send a 6-digit sign-in code by SMS.

Sign in with the SMS code. The first time a number is used, this creates a parent account (or a therapist's,
see `_new_account`).
New tokens for a refresh token. Each refresh token works once.
Sign out on this device.

An admin's code from the authenticator app (A13.1): new tokens that may act as admin. Each code works once.
409 second_step_not_set (no authenticator yet: `uv run python -m app.cli reset-second-step <phone>` on the
server), 400 invalid_code, 429 too_many_tries.
Sign out on every device.

get.description: The basic consent text to show at sign-up.

delete.description:
A parent deletes their account: their own family, its children with everything about them, and the account
itself, at once; the files follow overnight. Helping in another family ends too. Staff and therapist accounts
are closed by an admin (403 ask_admin).

patch.description: Change your name, language, city or district. Only the fields sent are changed.
The sign-up step: basic consent, city and district (spec §4). Required before anything else.

get.description: The helpers and open invites of the family this person belongs to (their own first).

post.description:
Owner only. 409 too_many_helpers (the limit is a setting, 1 now), already_member, already_invited,
not_a_parent (staff and therapists cannot be helpers).

delete.description: Owner only. The helper's next request already gets "not found" for the family's children.

get.description: Invites to help in another family, made for this person's number.

schema.title: Response My Invites Api V1 Me Helper Invites Get

post.description: Join the family as its helper. The family's children then appear in GET /children.
The owner chooses to try Pro: 7 days, once per family (409 trial_used; 403 owner_only for a helper).

A simulated payment: the family is Pro for 30 days per month paid. Payments stay simulated until after the
pilot (TASKS.md section 3); the production server refuses this (403 payments_not_available).
An admin makes the family this parent owns Pro for some days (for example after a payment by hand).
Create a physiotherapist, clinic or admin account by phone number.

get.description: Everyone, newest first.

schema.title: Response Users Api V1 Admin Users Get

patch.description: Change a person's role, or disable / enable their account. Every change goes into the audit log.

get.description: Newest first; `target` keeps one person's, child's or order's entries.

schema.title: Response Audit Logs Api V1 Admin Audit Logs Get
Response Feature Flags Api V1 Admin Feature Flags Get

put.description: 404 for a flag that does not exist. The change goes into the audit log.

get.description: Which features are on, for every signed-in person.

schema.title: Response Flags Api V1 Flags Get

get.description: Every place, hidden ones too: flagged ones first, then by region, district and name.

schema.title: Response List Places Api V1 Admin Places Get

get.description:
Places that help with this need (all places without one): free state centres first, then by distance from
the parent's position, or without it the parent's district, then region, first. Hidden places never show.

schema.title: Response Search Api V1 Places Get

post.description:
A wrong price or a closed place: the place is flagged for our team. A second report by the same person
changes nothing.

schema.title: Response My Places Api V1 Clinic Places Get

get.description: This place's free times from now on, earliest first.

schema.title: Response Slots Api V1 Clinic Places  Place Id  Slots Get

post.description:
422 slot_in_past, slot_too_far (more than 3 months ahead); 409 slot_overlaps when the same specialist (or
the place, when no specialist is named) already has a time then.

get.description: The free times still to come, earliest first. A taken time is not listed.

schema.title: Response Free Slots Api V1 Places  Place Id  Slots Get

post.description: 409 slot_taken when someone booked it first; 422 slot_gone (past or removed), mode_not_offered.

get.description: This child's bookings, cancelled ones too, by time.

schema.title: Response Family Bookings Api V1 Children  Child Id  Bookings Get

post.description: The time is free again for others.

get.description: Bookings of this place from now on, earliest first; cancelled ones too.

schema.title: Response Clinic Bookings Api V1 Clinic Places  Place Id  Bookings Get

post.description: Confirm, and for an online session give the link (422 online_link_needed without one).

schema.title: Response Kits Api V1 Kits Get

get.description: The family's orders, newest first; every member sees them.

schema.title: Response Family Orders Api V1 Family Kit Orders Get

post.description:
Owner only. 422 allergy_needed (P17a unanswered, or "yes" without which materials), unknown_kit,
address_needed, unknown_place, invalid_phone, invalid_district.
Owner only, while the order is still placed (409 too_late after our team confirmed it).

get.description: Every order, the open ones first, newest first.

schema.title: Response All Orders Api V1 Admin Kit Orders Get

patch.description:
placed -> confirmed -> shipped -> delivered; cancelled before shipping. 409 invalid_status_change otherwise.
An order with material allergies is confirmed only with allergyChecked (409 allergy_not_checked).

get.description: The children of every family this person belongs to.

schema.title: Response List Children Api V1 Children Get

delete.description: Deletes the child and, through the database, everything stored about them; the files follow overnight.

post.description:
Emergency words (A9.3) get the fixed 103 answer first, before any limit or AI. 429 daily_limit when a Free family
used today's messages; 503 ai_unavailable when the AI does not answer. An answer that mentions a movement the
child must avoid is replaced by a fixed safe answer.

get.description: This person's chat about the child, oldest first. Kept until they (or the family's owner) delete it.

schema.title: Response My Chat Api V1 Children  Child Id  Assistant Messages Get

delete.description: The family's owner deletes any adult's chat about the child ("Everything we store").

get.description:
What the family asked the assistant about this child: topics and warnings only, never the chat (spec §12).
Therapists' own chats about the child are not part of it (A9.9).
The last 7 days (Tashkent), in two sentences. Free and Pro. 404 no_plan before the first plan.
Why the current plan is what it is, in two sentences. 404 no_plan before the first plan.
Owner only. A JSON file with the child and, per table, every row about them.

put.description: Give or take back one consent. Owner only.

get.description: The answers saved so far, to continue where the parent stopped.

put.description: Save some answers. Answers already saved for other questions stay; the same question is overwritten.

get.description: Every round of this child, oldest first. Old rounds are never deleted (the child's history).

schema.title: Response List Rounds Api V1 Children  Child Id  Intake Get

post.description:
The repeat every 3 months: a new round, filled in with last time's answers, updated by the daily questions
answered since, for the parent to check.
Close the round once every required question has an answer ("Not sure" counts), and build the plan (A4.4).
Where to upload the parent's P39 voice note (at most 2 minutes), straight to storage.

get.description: The round's P39 voice note, for every member of the family; 404 when there is none.
The child's current (newest) 4-week plan, every day, and the reasons behind it. On Free: the first week.

Today's exercises and games (Tashkent date), after paused days moved the plan. On a paused day: paused, and
nothing to do. 404 no_task_today before the plan starts or after it ends; 403 pro_only past Free's first week.

post.description:
One tap: this exercise of that day of the current plan is done. Twice = once (200 with the first record).
404 when the plan has no such exercise that day; 409 not_yet for a day still to come.

patch.description:
The optional easy / ok / hard after Done; can be changed. Two "hard" in a row lower the exercise's level, two
"easy" raise it, unless a therapist fixed it.

post.description:
Pause today (Tashkent date): nothing to do, not missed; the rest of the plan moves one day later. Twice = once.
404 no_task_today before the plan starts or after it ends.

delete.description: Undo today's pause. Nothing happens when today is not paused.

get.description: Today's question, and the answer if already given.

put.description:
Answer today's question; can be changed today. The answer updates the child's profile: the next question
round (every 3 months) starts from it. 409 not_todays_question, 422 invalid_answer.

get.description:
The approved videos of today and the next 6 plan days, with links that work for 7 days, so the website and the
app can download them on Wi-Fi and play them offline (spec §8). Only physio-approved files (product rule 3).
`lang` defaults to the child's language. Pro only, unless Free includes it (A7.2).

schema.title: Response Offline Videos Api V1 Children  Child Id  Videos Get

post.description:
Invite a therapist to see this child. Owner only; needs the `therapist_share` consent. A phone invite sends
the therapist an SMS with the sign-in link; a link invite sends nothing (the parent passes the link on).

get.description: Open invites and active shares of this child, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Shares Api V1 Children  Child Id  Therapists Get

delete.description: Stop a share or take back an invite. Owner only. The therapist's next request already gets "not found".

get.description: Phone invites waiting for this therapist.

schema.title: Response My Invites Api V1 Therapist Invites Get

post.description: Accept a link invite. The code works once.
Accept a phone invite made for this therapist's number.

get.description: The children shared with this therapist right now.

schema.title: Response My Children Api V1 Therapist Children Get

get.description: One shared child. Anyone else, and a therapist whose share stopped, gets "not found".

For the parent: the latest intake answers as the plan uses them, which ones a therapist updated, and the
therapists' messages.
T1. 404 no_profile until the therapist fills it in.

put.description: Save some answers; the others stay. All valid, or nothing is saved. The answers are used at once.

post.description: Add an uploaded clip. 409 too_many_clips beyond 3 movement or 30 feedback clips.

get.description: The family's own clips with the therapists' replies, oldest first.

schema.title: Response Family Clips Api V1 Children  Child Id  Clips Get

delete.description: The clip, its replies and its file are gone.

schema.title: Response Therapist Clips Api V1 Therapist Children  Child Id  Clips Get

get.description: The child's access settings; 404 no_access_settings before the play check found them.

put.description: Save what the play check found (or what an adult corrected). Every game reads them.

post.description: Start a play check (again: a stopped one may be retried, spec §7).

get.description: The latest play check; 404 no_play_check before the first one.

patch.description: Next stage, the parent helped, stopped (upset or tired) or finished. A closed run cannot be opened again.

post.description:
A batch of tries, sent when the device is online. Tries older than 90 days are not kept. Every new clean try
moves θ of its area (Elo, spec §13); an access event never does (product rule 5).

get.description: θ of the six areas, for choosing games. Never shown to parents as a score (product rule 1).

schema.title: Response Get Skills Api V1 Children  Child Id  Skills Get

post.description: Correct the first guess with the play check: it wins over the intake by one step at most (spec §13, step 2).

schema.title: Response Place Api V1 Children  Child Id  Skills Placement Post

post.description: A sitting of play. 409 daily_limit once today's 20 minutes are played: the games sleep until tomorrow.

patch.description:
The session's game time so far. It never goes back, and never beyond the time since the session started (plus
a minute for clocks), so a device cannot fake more or less play.

get.description:
Today's games: an easy win, a growth game and the child's choice (spec §13). Open games are the levels up to
one past the highest tried; at most one new kind of game a week; a game already played is never taken away.

schema.title: Response List Cards Api V1 Children  Child Id  Voice Cards Get

post.description: A new card. 409 too_many_cards beyond 200.

patch.description: Change what was sent; a new photo or recording replaces the old file.

delete.description: The card and its files are gone.

post.description: A short-lived link to upload one video file straight to storage.

Register an uploaded file as the exercise's video in that language. It replaces the old file, and waits for
review again even if the old one was approved.

get.description: Videos with this status (by default: waiting for review), oldest first, with their tags and history.

schema.title: Response Review Queue Api V1 Review Videos Get

post.description:
Approve, reject, or ask for changes. Rejecting and asking for changes need a note for the video team. Every
decision is kept with who, when and which file, and goes into the audit log.

get.description:
The exercise's video in this language, only once a physiotherapist approved it (product rule 3). Anything
else, even a video waiting for review, answers "not found". Uzbek Cyrillic gets the Uzbek video.

AccessSettings.title: AccessSettings
AccessSettings.description: The five access settings the play check finds (spec §7). Values outside the spec's ranges are refused.

Feeling.title: Feeling
Feeling.description: The parent's optional answer after Done (spec §8). Two "hard" in a row lower the level, two "easy" raise it.

Need.title: Need
Need.description: What the parent picks in plain words (spec §11); "I'm not sure" is not a need of a place.

Placement.title: Placement
Placement.description: The play check's stage 2: for each area played, can the child do it now (spec §7).

Profession.title: Profession
Profession.description: Who can join (spec §6). The profession decides which form answers are required.

TryIn.title: TryIn
TryIn.description: One try, as the website records it (lib/tries.ts, spec §7).

VideoLang.title: VideoLang
VideoLang.description: Videos are voiced in 3 languages (V3); Uzbek Cyrillic users get the Uzbek video.
